nodes.label: Enterprise / Business
nodes.description: Business planning, finance, logistics, commercial processes and enterprise-wide systems.

nodes.label: Manufacturing Operations
nodes.description: Manufacturing operations management: execution, quality, maintenance, inventory and production coordination.

nodes.label: Supervisory Control
nodes.description: Supervision, visualization, alarming and process monitoring.

nodes.label: Basic Control
nodes.description: Controllers and devices that manipulate or regulate the physical process.

nodes.label: Physical Process
nodes.description: Machines, production lines, sensors, actuators and the physical process.

nodes.label: Data & Integration
nodes.description: Moving, contextualizing, storing and exposing industrial data.

nodes.label: Software Architecture
nodes.description: Application structure, services, APIs, middleware and reusable software building blocks.

nodes.label: Delivery / DevOps
nodes.description: Version control, build, test, deployment, infrastructure and operations workflows.

nodes.label: Security / DevSecOps
nodes.description: Identity, authorization, segmentation, secrets and security controls across the lifecycle.

nodes.label: AI / Agentic Systems
nodes.description: LLMs, agents, MCP, retrieval and AI-assisted engineering/operations.

nodes.label: Edge / Cloud / Platform
nodes.description: Runtime placement and infrastructure patterns from plant-floor edge to cloud.

nodes.label: ERP
nodes.description: Enterprise Resource Planning. Finance, purchasing, orders, material planning and business logistics.

nodes.label: CRM
nodes.description: Customer Relationship Management.

nodes.label: SCM
nodes.description: Supply Chain Management.

nodes.label: WMS
nodes.description: Warehouse Management System.

nodes.label: PLM
nodes.description: Product Lifecycle Management.

nodes.label: APS
nodes.description: Advanced Planning and Scheduling.

nodes.label: BI / Analytics
nodes.description: Business intelligence, reporting and analytical applications.

nodes.label: MES
nodes.description: Manufacturing Execution System. Coordinates and tracks production execution.

nodes.label: MOM
nodes.description: Manufacturing Operations Management. Broader umbrella around production, quality, maintenance and inventory operations.

nodes.label: OEE
nodes.description: Overall Equipment Effectiveness = Availability × Performance × Quality.

nodes.label: QMS
nodes.description: Quality Management System / quality operations.

nodes.label: CMMS / EAM
nodes.description: Maintenance work management and asset lifecycle management.

nodes.label: Batch / Recipe
nodes.description: Recipe, batch execution and procedural control concepts.

nodes.label: Track & Trace / Genealogy
nodes.description: Material, lot and product genealogy across production.

nodes.label: Production Scheduling
nodes.description: Finite or dispatch-level scheduling of production work.

nodes.label: SCADA
nodes.description: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition. Supervises, visualizes and interacts with industrial processes.

nodes.label: HMI
nodes.description: Human-Machine Interface used by operators to visualize and control a process.

nodes.label: Historian
nodes.description: Time-series storage optimized for process and operational history.

nodes.label: Alarm Management
nodes.description: Alarm generation, prioritization, routing, acknowledgement and lifecycle management.

nodes.label: PLC
nodes.description: Programmable Logic Controller.

nodes.label: DCS
nodes.description: Distributed Control System, common in continuous/process industries.

nodes.label: RTU
nodes.description: Remote Terminal Unit, common in distributed telemetry/control.

nodes.label: PAC
nodes.description: Programmable Automation Controller.

nodes.label: I/O
nodes.description: Input/output modules connecting controllers to field devices.

nodes.label: Sensors
nodes.description: Devices that measure the physical process.

nodes.label: Actuators
nodes.description: Valves, motors, drives and devices that affect the physical process.

nodes.label: VFD / Drives
nodes.description: Variable Frequency Drives and motor control devices.

nodes.label: DataOps
nodes.description: People, processes and technology for delivering trusted, usable data reliably to consumers.

nodes.label: Industrial DataOps
nodes.description: DataOps applied to OT/industrial data: connectivity, contextualization, standardization, governance and delivery.

nodes.label: Data Engineering
nodes.description: Building pipelines and transformations for collecting, validating, modeling and delivering data.

nodes.label: ETL / ELT
nodes.description: Extract-transform-load / extract-load-transform data pipeline patterns.

nodes.label: Contextualization
nodes.description: Adding asset, hierarchy, units, semantics and relationships so raw data becomes meaningful.

nodes.label: UNS
nodes.description: Unified Namespace. Event-driven shared namespace for normalized industrial information, often implemented with MQTT.

nodes.label: MQTT
nodes.description: Lightweight publish/subscribe messaging protocol.

nodes.label: Sparkplug B
nodes.description: Industrial MQTT specification defining topic namespace, payload and state management.

nodes.label: OPC UA
nodes.description: Industrial interoperability standard for secure, structured data exchange.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.description: HTTP-based resource-oriented application interface.

nodes.label: GraphQL
nodes.description: Query-oriented API technology.

nodes.label: Pub/Sub
nodes.description: Publish/subscribe messaging pattern that decouples producers and consumers.

nodes.label: Event Streaming
nodes.description: Continuous transport and processing of ordered events, often with Kafka-like platforms.

nodes.label: Message Broker
nodes.description: Infrastructure that receives, routes and distributes messages/events.

nodes.label: Data Contract
nodes.description: Explicit agreement on schema, semantics, quality and ownership between data producer and consumer.

nodes.label: Time-series DB
nodes.description: Database optimized for timestamped observations.

nodes.label: Relational DB / SQL
nodes.description: Structured transactional/relational data storage and query.

nodes.label: Data Lake / Lakehouse
nodes.description: Large-scale analytical storage, often combining object storage with table/warehouse semantics.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph
nodes.description: Graph of entities and relationships used to represent context and semantics.

nodes.label: Semantic Model
nodes.description: Formal representation of meaning, entities, relationships and business/industrial concepts.

nodes.label: Frontend / UI
nodes.description: User-facing application layer, e.g. Perspective or React.

nodes.label: Backend / Service
nodes.description: Server-side business logic, APIs, workers and integrations.

nodes.label: Middleware
nodes.description: Software between systems that handles integration, translation, messaging or orchestration.

nodes.label: API
nodes.description: Defined interface through which software systems exchange functionality or data.

nodes.label: Microservices
nodes.description: Architecture where capabilities are split into independently deployable services.

nodes.label: Monolith
nodes.description: Application architecture where many capabilities are packaged and deployed together.

nodes.label: Event-driven Architecture
nodes.description: Architecture based on producing, consuming and reacting to events.

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.description: Version-controlled source of code/configuration, commonly Git.

nodes.label: SDK
nodes.description: Software Development Kit: libraries, tools and examples for building against a platform.

nodes.label: Runtime
nodes.description: Environment in which an application executes.

nodes.label: DevOps
nodes.description: Practices joining software development and operations across planning, build, delivery and operation.

nodes.label: DevSecOps
nodes.description: DevOps with security and compliance integrated throughout the lifecycle.

nodes.label: Git
nodes.description: Distributed version control system.

nodes.label: CI/CD
nodes.description: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment.

nodes.label: Infrastructure as Code
nodes.description: Infrastructure defined and managed through version-controlled declarative or scripted configuration.

nodes.label: Ansible
nodes.description: Automation/configuration management tool commonly used for deployment and infrastructure tasks.

nodes.label: Docker / Containers
nodes.description: Application packaging and isolation using containers.

nodes.label: Kubernetes
nodes.description: Container orchestration platform.

nodes.label: Build Artifact
nodes.description: Versioned deployable output produced by a build/release process.

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.description: Understanding system behavior through logs, metrics and traces.

nodes.label: SRE
nodes.description: Site Reliability Engineering: applying software engineering to operations and reliability.

nodes.label: IAM
nodes.description: Identity and Access Management.

nodes.label: Identity Provider (IdP)
nodes.description: System that authenticates users and issues identity assertions/tokens.

nodes.label: RBAC
nodes.description: Role-Based Access Control.

nodes.label: MFA / 2FA
nodes.description: Multi-factor authentication.

nodes.label: Secrets Management
nodes.description: Secure storage, retrieval, rotation and auditing of passwords, tokens, keys and certificates.

nodes.label: Zero Trust
nodes.description: Security model based on continuous verification and least privilege rather than implicit network trust.

nodes.label: Network Segmentation
nodes.description: Separating systems/zones to reduce attack paths and control traffic.

nodes.label: Industrial DMZ
nodes.description: Buffer zone between enterprise IT and industrial control networks.

nodes.label: Purdue Model
nodes.description: Hierarchical reference model commonly used to discuss industrial architecture and network segmentation.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.description: Large Language Model.

nodes.label: AI Agent
nodes.description: LLM-driven system that can reason, select tools and perform actions toward a goal.

nodes.label: Agentic Development
nodes.description: Software development where agents inspect code/context, modify files, run tools and iterate on tasks.

nodes.label: MCP
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol: standard interface for exposing tools and context to AI agents.

nodes.label: RAG
nodes.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: retrieving external context and supplying it to a model at generation time.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.description: Vector representations used for semantic search, retrieval and similarity.

nodes.label: Vector DB
nodes.description: Storage/search optimized for embedding vectors.

nodes.label: Prompt Injection
nodes.description: Untrusted content attempts to manipulate an AI system into ignoring or overriding intended instructions.

nodes.label: Tool Calling
nodes.description: Model selects and invokes external functions/tools.

nodes.label: Context Window / Tokens
nodes.description: Amount of text/tool context a model can process in one request; token usage often affects API cost.

nodes.label: Edge Computing
nodes.description: Running compute close to machines/processes for latency, resilience or bandwidth reasons.

nodes.label: Cloud
nodes.description: Externally hosted compute/storage/platform services.

nodes.label: On-premises
nodes.description: Systems hosted on infrastructure physically or administratively controlled by the organization.

nodes.label: Hybrid Architecture
nodes.description: Architecture spanning edge/on-prem and cloud.

nodes.label: Ignition
nodes.description: Industrial application platform commonly used for SCADA, HMI, historian, MES integrations and industrial data applications.

nodes.label: Ignition Perspective
nodes.description: Ignition web visualization module for industrial applications.

nodes.label: HighByte Intelligence Hub
nodes.description: Industrial DataOps platform focused on industrial connectivity, contextualization, modeling and data delivery.

nodes.label: React
nodes.description: JavaScript UI library used for building web frontends.

nodes.label: Kepware / OPC Server
nodes.description: Industrial connectivity layer exposing device data through protocols such as OPC UA.
